prayerExcerpt.en-US: The garden affords a beautiful emblem of a Christian's continual progress in the path of virtue.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: O jardim oferece um belo emblema do contínuo progresso de um cristão no caminho da virtude.

meta.face: A Greek of about forty-five, sun-darkened and weathered from the soil, with a LEAN, ANGULAR face and a CLASSICAL GREEK PROFILE — the long, straight nose running on from the forehead with almost no dip at the bridge, SHARP, HIGH cheekbones with hollows beneath, a LONG, strong jaw, deep-set green-brown eyes with fine crow's feet, level black brows, a WIDE, thin-lipped mouth; short-cropped black hair greying at the temples; a close-trimmed short black beard following the jaw; a steady, open gaze.
meta.basis: No likeness survives; the book's engraving shows a bearded, robed gardener with a spade and watering pot rebuking the woman at his garden fence, and the card keeps the spade and the garden. His Greek birth and Sirmium are the book's; Sirmium lay on the Sava (Wikipedia). The classical profile is our choice.
